006package dev.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter;
007
008import java.math.BigInteger;
009import java.util.List;
010
011import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
012import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IPositiveIntegerItem;
013import dev.metaschema.core.qname.EQNameFactory;
014import dev.metaschema.core.qname.IEnhancedQName;
015import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
016import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
017
018/**
019 * Support for the Metaschema <a href=
020 * "https://pages.nist.gov/metaschema/specification/datatypes/#positive-integer">positive-integer</a>
021 * data type.
022 */
023public class PositiveIntegerAdapter
024    extends AbstractIntegerAdapter<IPositiveIntegerItem> {
025  @NonNull
026  private static final List<IEnhancedQName> NAMES = ObjectUtils.notNull(
027      List.of(
028          EQNameFactory.instance().newQName(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH, "positive-integer"),
029          // for backwards compatibility with original type name
030          EQNameFactory.instance().newQName(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH, "positiveInteger")));
031
032  PositiveIntegerAdapter() {
033    super(IPositiveIntegerItem.class, IPositiveIntegerItem::cast);
034    // avoid general construction
035  }
036
037  @Override
038  public List<IEnhancedQName> getNames() {
039    return NAMES;
040  }
041
042  @Override
043  public IPositiveIntegerItem newItem(Object value) {
044    BigInteger item = toValue(value);
045    return IPositiveIntegerItem.valueOf(item);
046  }
047}
